blocks.src: I HEARD THAT MANY PEOPLE WITH SEVERED MERIDIANS WERE GENIUSES.
blocks.tr: J'AI ENTENDU DIRE QUE BEAUCOUP DE GENS SOUFFRANT DE MÉRIDIENS COUPÉS ÉTAIENT DES GÉNIES.

blocks.src: THERE ARE COUNTLESS PEOPLE WHO DESTROYED THEIR OWN SECTS.
blocks.tr: IL Y A D'INNOMBRABLES PERSONNES QUI ONT DÉTRUIT LEURS PROPRES SECTES.

blocks.src: ALL I DID WAS WATCH OVER THE STORAGE.
blocks.tr: TOUT CE QUE J'AI FAIT ÉTAIT SURVEILLE LE STOCKAGE.

blocks.src: HE THINKS I AM JUST A MARTIAL ARTIST HIDING MY ABILITIES... IS THAT SO?
blocks.tr: IL PENSE QUE JE SUIS JUSTE UN ARTISTE MARTIAL CACHANT MES CAPACITÉS ... EST-CE QUE ÇA?
